title: Rest in the nearness already given
summary: Grace makes the Beloved known as intimate, not distant. Let the chase quiet when the True Guru points to the One already near.
takeaway: Stop chasing what grace has already brought near.
lifeApplication: When seeking turns frantic, stop for one breath and name the gift: the Kind Beloved has not hidden Himself from the heart He is teaching.

source.shortMeaning: Grace turns distance into intimacy as the True Guru reveals the Beloved already near.
source.lifeApplication: When tired seeking returns, let the Guru's showing matter more than the mind's chase.

evidence.coreClaim: Grace turns distance into intimacy as the True Guru reveals the Beloved already near.
evidence.turn: Let the Guru's showing end the exhausted assumption that the Beloved is far away.
evidence.practicalImplication: When seeking turns frantic, stop for one breath and name the gift: the Kind Beloved has not hidden Himself from the heart He is teaching.
